object_description: elemental composition organized around a three-level central atrium
design_condition: The building is placed on the embankment with a partial basement, limiting excavation and maintaining a balanced relationship with the existing buildings and terrain.

positive.statement: The location is intelligently defined in relation to the topography and limits ground excavation.
The composition has undeniable qualities despite not offering a strong emblematic form.
The central hall welcomes visitors and provides convincing access to the major spaces.
The walkways crossing the central void ensure efficient and convincing circulation.
The independent modular facade has a dynamic appearance through its irregular folded rhythm.
The phased implementation provides functional interest as a gathering place for public events.

negative.statement: The open central atrium generates noise and limits simultaneous uses of the building.
The facade expression is unconvincing relative to the additional life-cycle costs it would generate.
The proposed re-naturalization appears to circumvent the road-related problem.
